This land I farm is not mine, I rent it, so I must be careful with what I spend. Maize needs feeding to give good yield, so I will buy some urea and NPK if the price is not too high this season, but only small bag because money is tight. I keep small goats and chickens, so I carry their droppings to the field before planting. I cannot irrigate here in the North East, we depend on the rains, and I use the seed I saved from last harvest because improved seed from the market costs too much. My children and I will work the plot ourselves, but at weeding and harvest time I will call two or three people to help for a few days.
